name: [HOLIDAYS UPDATE] ULTRA: Rebirth
desc:
Welcome to ULTRAMAN: NEO, the definitive Ultraman experience on Roblox! With 200+ playable characters, there's much to explore and learn in this faithful tokusatsu sandbox! Play as fan-favorites like Zero, Tiga, and Mebius, classic kaiju like Gomora and Zetton, unlockable powerhouses like Five King and Ultraman Gruebe, or even the multitudes of characters in our gamepasses! 

CONTROLS:
Shift = sprint
Double jump = hover
Shift while hovering = flight
Double jump + Sprint = flight dash

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Make sure to join our Roblox group at Hikari's Forge for special character unlocks! You may also join our community server to keep up with the latest news, and follow our social media.
